practiceReport.name: Zachariah Branch
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (WR) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: After being sidelined for the Falcons' previous two games, Branch isn't yet back to full health coming out of a Week 11 bye. The Falcons will see what, if anything, Branch is able to do at practices Thursday and Friday before deciding whether he'll carry a designation into Sunday's game against the Vikings. The rookie third-round pick out of Georgia has been a regular presence on the Falcons' return units but hasn't seen much involvement on offense when healthy; he's recorded 10 catches for 64 yards on 12 targets through his first eight NFL appearances.

practiceReport.name: Jahan Dotson
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (70% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
practiceReport.beatComment: It's the second straight missed practice for Dotson, who is dealing with a hamstring issue. That's not a good sign ahead of Sunday's Week 12 clash against Minnesota, but Dotson will have one more chance to get on the practice field Friday. If he ends up being sidelined Sunday, Olamide Zaccheaus could take on a larger offensive snap share, as could Zachariah Branch, though he's also looking iffy to suit up due to a hamstring issue of his own.

practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (72% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
factors: Mid-week downgrade (Wed FP -> Thu LP); monitoring Friday clearance
Coaching/beat trend (beat report): late setback / downgraded outlook
practiceReport.beatComment: Daniels has been dealing with an Achilles issue since late October, but is hasn't yet caused him to miss any games. With that in mind, unless he's suffered a setback, Daniels seems likely to suit up Sunday in Minnesota. He's had a solid rookie season, tallying 69 tackles, including 1.0 sacks, two defensed passes (including an interception) and one fumble recovery through 10 contests.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Anterio Thompson
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 11 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Placed on Injured Reserve (Undisclosed) ahead of Week 8; must miss at least 4 games (earliest eligible Week 13).

irAndReserveTracker.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 11 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Robinson already has missed two games due to a lingering hamstring injury and now must miss at least the next four outings, meaning his next chance for game action is Sunday, Dec. 13 at Cleveland. In a corresponding move, the Falcons are signing Khalil Herbert from the practice squad to the active roster to continue serving as the No. 2 RB behind workhorse Bijan Robinson.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Samson Ebukam
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 11 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Ebukam suffered a hamstring injury in Week 9 versus the Buccaneers, and he will now be forced to miss at least four contests as a result of the injury. In his absence, Za'Darius Smith is a top candidate to operate in a more prominent role at outside linebacker.

irAndReserveTracker.name: JD Bertrand
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: The nature of Bertrand's injury is not clear, but the move to IR means the third-year pro will be forced to miss at least the first four games of the regular season, making Week 5 against the Ravens on Sunday, Oct. 11 the earliest he can return. He logged 35 tackles (13 solo) and two pass defenses across 15 regular-season games in 2025, contributing both on defense and special teams.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Michael Jerrell
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 11 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Jerrell was already ruled out for Sunday's game against the 49ers due to a biceps injury. He's now required to miss at least four games, so the next time he's eligible to play is Week 12 against the Vikings on Sunday, Nov. 29. Jerrell's absence leaves the Falcons with less depth on the offensive line.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Da'Shawn Hand
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Hand's move to injured reserve comes as no surprise since it was previously announced that he'd miss the remainder of the season due to a torn quadriceps suffered during the team's Week 1 loss to the Steelers. The 30-year-old played just seven defensive snaps and failed to log any stats before getting hurt and will now shift his focus to getting healthy for the 2027 campaign.

irAndReserveTracker.name: DeAngelo Malone
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Malone was initially placed on the active/PUP list this past Wednesday due to an undisclosed injury. Now that he's on the reserve/PUP, Malone will be required to miss the entire 2026 season unless he reaches an injury settlement with the Falcons. He appeared in nine regular-season games for Atlanta last year and finished with eight tackles (two solo) and one interception.
